svg.title: Conceptual receiver power and RF partitioning
svg.desc: The optical cage and digital circuitry need controlled power and thermal behaviour alongside the clock and analogue circuits. This is a conceptual partition, not a grounding schematic. Reference-clock coax may reconnect chassis electrically.
